chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Musa ibn Ja'far, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from Umar ibn Salma, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Eating the broad-beans enhances the two thighs, and increases in the brain, and gives birth to fresh blood.

key_terms.يُمَخِّخُ: Strengthens or makes firm (specifically referring to the thighs/legs)

ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits of eating broad beans according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the nutritional efficacy of broad beans (*baqalli*), noting their ability to strengthen the legs, augment brain matter, and generate fresh blood. This reflects the Shia tradition of integrating practical medicine (*al-tibb*) with spiritual teachings, emphasizing that dietary choices directly influence physical vitality and humoral balance.
